# Kadi Research Studio

> Kadi Research Studio turns journal PDFs and DOCX drafts into a structured literature review: an eleven-column evidence matrix, a field synthesis, and publication-ready drafts written to your journal's own guideline. Built for PhD candidates and their supervisors.

Kadi is a web research studio for doctoral work. It automates the tabulating — reading each article into a fixed taxonomy, filling an evidence matrix, synthesising themes and gaps — while the researcher keeps the appraisal and the judgement. Manuscripts and proposals are drafted section-by-section against a journal's publication guideline, with word budgets and checklists enforced and audited before submission.

## Key facts

- Eleven-column evidence matrix per article (Author, Year, Title, Journal, Problems/Gaps, Objectives, Theory, Empirical findings, Methodology, Key Findings, Limitations).
- Every claim the AI writes is grounded in articles the researcher actually reviewed; unread citations are flagged, never fabricated.
- PDFs are read in the browser, not uploaded — the binary never leaves the user's machine.
- Prepaid token pricing; every account starts with 100,000 free tokens.
- Built for quantitative, qualitative and mixed-methods research, and for articles, proposals and abstracts.
